reply_text:
Two findings in `receipt-lines` against `main`:

1. **[P1] Printed prices are 100× too high** — `receipt/render.py:2`
   `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`. Two coffees at 450 cents print as `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`.
   **Fix:** Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add a literal expected-value assertion—the current `RenderTest.test_render_line` computes its expectation using the same broken formatter.

2. **[P2] Right-alignment isn’t connected to receipt rendering** — `receipt/render.py:7`
   `render_line` still uses a fixed 20-character name field rather than the new 32-column `align` helper. Amounts of different lengths end in different columns.
   **Fix:** Render through `align(name, format_money(total))` and test that differently sized amounts end at column 32.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
